text:
Ashwin: kicking off schema migration for customer_profiles (add last_seen + TTL index). maintenance lull window now. tagging @deploybot to start the pipeline. ETA ~20-30m, pls ack.

deploybot: migration job started: mig-20260323-45 on node gpu-3. streaming logs here. will auto-pause if lock_time > 15s. :robot_face:

Maria: quick q — any long-running analytics jobs touching customer_profiles right now?

Jordan: we have 2 adhoc analytics jobs but low qps. i'm draining read replica rr-us-east-2 for the table for ~10m to avoid KV pressure. command I ran: `/drain-rr rr-us-east-2 --table=customer_profiles --timeout=10m`

Sam: adding this to release notes draft: "add last_seen + TTL index; migration during maintenance window; non-breaking for client reads." pinning release to v2.1.0-rc3 for rollout.

SRE-Oncall: need explicit rollback criteria. what's the pause vs full rollback threshold?

Ashwin: good call. pause conditions: lock_time > 15s OR replica_lag > 60s sustained for >2m -> migrator will pause and create a holdpin. full rollback triggers: migration fails 3x OR write error rate spikes >50% above baseline for 5m. rollback steps (quick):
```
-- stop migrator service 
SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ~ 'ALTER TABLE customer_profiles' AND state <> 'idle';
-- revert schema change
ALTER TABLE customer_profiles DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS last_seen;
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_customer_profiles_ttl;
```
Follow full runbook if rollback: revert code deploy, run sanity reads, then re-open window.

deploybot: acknowledged. holdpoint hook added: if pause condition met i'll pin release and post here + #eng-releases. current throughput: ~120 rows/sec, no locks observed so far.

Maria: i'll keep an eye on query planner and watch for any unexpected sequential scans. ping me if you want an EXPLAIN on any backfill chunk.

Jordan: starting replica drain now, tailing lag expected ~5-12s. will report when drain complete.

Sam: release notes updated and pinned; cc @product for visibility. :memo:

Ashwin: thanks all. i'll post another checkpoint after the next 10k rows processed. standby for any holdpoint events.
